name: reception-week
title: Reception week
subtitle: Fictional demo records. Local records require staff reconciliation.

sections.title: Expected arrivals
sections.sql: select code,site,visitor_name,host,expected_at,status from v_arrivals order by expected_at

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: select * from v_attention order by site,code

name: onsite
title: Visitors recorded onsite
subtitle: A point-in-time reception register, not an emergency accountability system.

sections.sql: select * from v_onsite order by site,checked_in_at

sections.title: Retention decisions
sections.sql: select * from v_retention order by retention_due

sections.title: Evidence gaps
sections.sql: select * from v_compliance order by site,code,rule
